title: fix(metadata)!: a package-less object-bound action row is keyed per (object, name) on the stored side, so a package-less save never lands in another object's holder
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDZYUbJbnXUTqZoZ56k4czR)_
Part of #32681

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`DatabaseLoader` 存一条不属于任何包、绑在某对象上的 `action` 行时，按 `(对象, 名字)` 数持有者（和内存注册表一致），不再按名字数所有包；它按槽读行时，把"名字被两个包持有、只有一个包绑了同一对象"的包外行当作那个包的定制，排在该包自己的行前面交出。
- 为什么改：席位裁决 A（2026-11-14T16:12Z）：包外行按 `(对象, 名字)` 归属。之前 ALPHA 绑 `account`、BETA 绑 `contact` 时，包外的 `account` 存档写成包外行（而注册表把它当 ALPHA 的定制）；只有 BETA 绑 `contact` 时，包外的 `account` 存档被写成 BETA 的 `account` 绑定（BETA 从没声明过）；启动预载前后点名 ALPHA 的读答案不同。
- 风险与回滚：只影响接了 `DatabaseLoader` 的宿主（工作区内 0 处）；库里已有的行不改不迁移，只改新写入落在哪一行、以及冷读怎么归属；回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts` 的 `slottedSaveTarget`（风险 hunk：按 `storeRowSlotKey` 分槽、按包桶命名未命名行）与 `loadManySlots`；`packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts` 的 `storeRowWriteKey` 与 `pluralEntryCustomizedHolders`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts -t 32681`，预期新增用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。镜像形状（ALPHA 绑 `account`、包外行绑 `contact`）的启动预载修复依赖 #33299 先合入，见 Acceptance notes。

## What changes

Seat ruling A on #32681: a package-less action row bound to an object is keyed per `(object, name)` everywhere, as ADR-0150 D4 keys an action by `(package, objectName, name)`.

- **Save** (`DatabaseLoader.save` through `slottedSaveTarget`): rows are keyed as the in-memory store keys items (`storeRowSlotKey`), and `storeRowWriteKey` counts the holders of the written body's identity (`slotIdentityOf`: an object-bound action's object and name), as `storeWriteKey` already does in memory. A package binding the name to another object is a different key, never a holder of this one. The unique-key bucket a pending object-naming acts on is still the package's (every row of the package the write's slots belong to).
- **Slot read** (`DatabaseLoader.loadManySlots`, and `loadSlots`, which filters it): a package-less action row bound to an object that exactly one package binds the name to, under a name two or more packages hold, is handed on held for that package, just before that package's own row of the object (`pluralEntryCustomizedHolders`). That is where the boot priming pass files it: the unscoped plural read keeps it apart from both holders, and the pass registers it after them, so the store's `(object, name)` write rule puts it in that package's slot. Readers that keep a slot's first item (`slotStoreOf`, `list`) now answer it without the pass too. The row is not rebound: no write, its `package_id` stays empty.

Every moved answer, FROM to TO (host wiring a `DatabaseLoader`; ALPHA and BETA are two packages, `approve` the action name):

| Shape | Answer | FROM | TO |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| ALPHA `approve` on `account`, BETA's on `contact`; a package-less save of `approve` on `account` | the row written | a new package-less row bound to `account` | ALPHA's `account` row (its customization, D4) |
| BETA's `approve` on `contact` alone; a package-less save of `approve` on `account` | the row written | a new row with `package_id` BETA bound to `account` (a binding BETA never declared) | a new package-less row bound to `account` |
| ALPHA's `approve` on `account` alone; a package-less save of an object-less `approve` | the row written | a new row with `package_id` ALPHA, object-less | a new package-less object-less row |
| BETA's `approve` on `contact` and a package-less row on `account`; ALPHA's first save of `approve` on `account` | the row written | a new ALPHA row beside the package-less one | the package-less row, updated and bound to ALPHA (a package's first item takes over the bare slot, as in memory) |
| ALPHA's row on `account`, BETA's on `contact`, a stored package-less row on `account` (any version order) | read naming ALPHA without the boot pass (`MetadataManager.get`) | ALPHA's own row | the package-less row, as after the pass |
| same | `list('action')` without the pass | ALPHA's row and the package-less row | the package-less row (ALPHA's slot), as after the pass |
| same | bare read, read naming BETA, every read after the pass | `409` naming ALPHA and BETA; BETA's row; as listed | unchanged |
| a package-less row on `o1`, then a package's save on `o2` | the row written | the package's save takes the `o1` row over | the package's own new row; the `o1` row keeps its column (moved #32540 pin) |
| ALPHA on `account`, BETA on `contact`, package-less save (A-B-save / B-save-A) | `/actions/account/approve` declaration | ALPHA's own body while ALPHA's slot holds the customization / refused `ambiguous-in-environment` (and `contact`: no declaration) | the item ALPHA's slot holds, ALPHA's handler run, in both orders |

The second row is the narrowing: an address naming BETA no longer reaches an `account` binding a package-less save wrote into BETA's bucket.

Not changed: types other than `action` (their identity is the name, and the slot read's new rule never fires for them); a name one package holds; stored rows (no migration: a stored package-less row is read as its holder's customization, never rebound; rows earlier saves wrote are listed by the ADR-0150 D10 report as before).

## Tests

- `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts` describe `[#32681]` (11 cases); the moved #32540 pin in `metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`; `packages/runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts` describe `[#32681]` (3 cases: real ObjectQL registry, protocol over a MetadataManager from the real MetadataPlugin boot pass, DatabaseLoader over a writable `sys_metadata` double routed through the engine dispatch asserts).
- BEFORE (observed with the fix reverted): A-B-save judged ALPHA's own body while ALPHA's slot read the customization; B-save-A refused the `account` route `ambiguous-in-environment` and found no `contact` declaration; the single-holder save stored a `[BETA, account]` row.

## Acceptance notes

- The mirror shape (ALPHA's `approve` on `account`, a package-less row on `contact`) is not in this PR. `DatabaseLoader`'s unscoped plural read folds the package-less `contact` row into ALPHA by name, so after the boot pass a read naming ALPHA answers the `contact` row where the read without the pass answers ALPHA's `account` row. Counting per `(object, name)` there hands both rows on, but `main`'s `MetadataManager.loadMany` then pairs bodies by content and stamps neither, the pass files ALPHA's body in the bare slot, and a read naming BETA would answer ALPHA's item. That half needs #33299's keyed-entry stamping first; it is not stacked here (AGENTS.md: a stacked series is not a supported form).
- Single-holder cell after boot (same fold as the mirror shape, follows #32680): with BETA's `approve` on `contact` alone and a package-less row on `account`, a read naming BETA after the boot pass still answers the `account` row and `/actions/contact/approve` finds no declaration — as on `main`. Carried by the follow-up on this card.
- The ADR-0150 D10/R15 report's `packageLessRowOwners` (area E1) still counts holders per name, so a package-less row this PR reads as ALPHA's customization is still listed as ambiguous there. Noted for E1.
- No change in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/**` or `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts`; in `database-loader.ts` only `slottedSaveTarget`, `loadManySlots`, the imports and one doc paragraph move (open PR #33193 edits the history functions).
